notes: The temporal בְּתִתִּי is divided by rule 52: when on the preposition, shall lay on the infinitive, I on the suffix (rule 18).
תוֹכְחוֹת חֵמָה → wrathful rebukes is a construct chain rendered attributively (rule 28).
The two בְּ ... them phrases are reordered after their objects; the units are simply moved (rule 25).
